Hello, Mastodon. I’ve been making Daybearing, an iPhone app that puts tasks on a clock face.

It keeps the time you planned and the time actually spent visible together—because a day rarely unfolds like a tidy list.

The public TestFlight is now open, and I’d genuinely appreciate feedback:

https://daybearing.com

https://testflight.apple.com/join/JJH3KVpF

#IndieDev #Productivity #iPhone #TestFlight #BuildInPublic #TimeManagement
